card.title: Closer on My Terms
card.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love a weekend to patch things up. Separate rooms, though, and no old arguments.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The old arguments are why we need the weekend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's start with a pleasant afternoon. We can rebuild from there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't fit everything I need to say into an afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send the rest by email. I'll read it when I'm ready, and we can keep the afternoon for us.

mechanism: A welcomes repair only while shrinking shared time and moving difficult material into a channel controlled by A.
confusable: Unlike refusing reconciliation outright, A must retain agreement to closeness while defining away its uncomfortable parts.
comparison: D95-b keeps a pleasant afternoon and deferred reading; D95-a keeps ten-o'clock departure and pre-pudding discussion.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
